title: 🤖 A new smart assistant reaches more phones!
body: 🤖 A new smart assistant reaches more phones!
Motorola has announced it is expanding its smart assistant, Qira, to work on more devices with Android 17, after it was previously exclusive to its newest phones.
The assistant understands voice commands, summarises your day for you in the "Catch Me Up" feature, helps you coordinate your outfits with your phone, and turns your photos into works of art.
Simply put, your phone now knows your habits, so it suggests what you need before you ask for it.
Do you use a smart assistant on your phone? And what feature would you like it to add?
